executionCheckoutContract: Detached clean HEAD for product code; evaluation-only files may be added after freeze. The shared primary checkout contains unrelated edits and is not used to execute product code.
status: research candidate; no production Jev integration exists

g28.spec: For partial field queries only, call Jev when the frozen baseline P4 verdict is confirmed or likely; a valid label-only choice replaces top-1 preference. No verdict promotion, binary fact creation, or truth-based gating.
g28.routing: partial && (baseline.currentVerdict === confirmed || baseline.currentVerdict === likely); exact, non-field, missing candidate and ambiguous verdict never route
g28.fallback: Any missing key, timeout, network or HTTP failure, malformed response, model mismatch or invalid candidate preserves exact baseline top-1 and verdict
g28.abstain: No explicit Jev abstain decision is wired; baseline ambiguous/none verdict remains unchanged. Jev unique and confidence values are diagnostic only.

promptContract.pick: Pick the existing field most likely to be the remembered target of the user phrase. This is a forced ranking preference, not proof. Use only listed candidate IDs.
promptContract.unique: Does the user phrase uniquely identify one of these candidates without additional context?
promptContract.candidateDescription: fieldName only; c0..cN in baseline ranked order

deterministicLexical.score: 10 * query-token matches in field + 0 * exact + 0.5 * max(0, field-token-count - matches) + 0 * class-token matches + 2 * suffix-match - baseline-rank * 1e-5
deterministicLexical.route: always choose highest score for partial; exact queries retain baseline
deterministicLexical.caveat: Exploratory benchmark-selected comparator, not a deployed production rule.

evaluationArms.B: frozen deterministic lexical comparator on partial, baseline on exact
evaluationArms.C: unchanged baseline plus literal G28 strong-only Jev label preference; not a deployed integration
evaluationArms.D: unchanged baseline plus Jev label preference on all partial rows with candidates; diagnostic force-all

routingConflict: The shipped assessJevEligibility module requires an ambiguous verdict, whereas G28 requires a strong verdict; their intersection is empty. The old deterministic-first illustration uses detOk (ground truth) to decide calls and is not an executable production router. No production-ready combined route is claimed or invented in this evaluation.
